whatsapp.title: Cast WhatsApp announcement — ready to send
whatsapp.text:
Hey CHOSEN family! Our “Come See Me in CHOSEN” flyers are ready!

Find your name and save your Post and Story flyers here:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/cast-flyers.html

Our launch week is November 9–15. Here’s the goal:
• Share your Post flyer once.
• Share your Story flyer twice.
• Personally invite five people.

Captions and the full sharing plan are here:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/cast-launch-kit.html

Send your guests this show link:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/chosen.html

The show is Sunday, December 20 at 6 PM at The Faith Center. Admission is free!

Parents and guardians, please help your child share. If you spot a flyer mistake or cannot find your name, let Ms. Lounise know before posting. Let’s invite our people!

schedule.detail: Choose one caption. Share your Post flyer and your first Story. Add the guest link.
Send five personal invitations to people you know. Follow up with anyone who replies.
Use Story 2. Add the guest link so people can save the date.
Use the short video prompt if you can. Record at home or at your next scheduled call; no extra rehearsal is needed.
Reply to questions and share the show details with anyone who is interested.
Share your invitation video or an approved rehearsal image. Keep story surprises for the show.
Check that you shared one Post, two Stories, and five personal invitations. Tell the production administrator if you need help.
